import subprocess, sys

sock = "/run/bench71582111/containerd/containerd.sock"

def ctr(*a):
    return subprocess.run(["sudo", "ctr", "-a", sock, *a], capture_output=True, text=True).stdout

with open(sys.argv[1], "w") as f:
    for ns in ctr("namespaces", "list", "-q").split():
        for line in ctr("-n", ns, "images", "list").splitlines()[1:]:
            ref, _type, digest = line.split()[:3]
            if not ref.startswith("sha256:"):
                f.write("%s %s %s\n" % (ns, ref, digest))
